Breakfast.

Spend the day exploring the Peruvian capital at your own pace. Stroll through its scenic neighbourhoods, visit museums and souvenir shops, or try Peruvian dishes in a local café.

You can add the optional full-day excursion “Ballestas Islands and the Mysterious Nazca Lines”.

Price: USD 550 per person (net).

Early in the morning, take a tourist coach from Lima to the coastal town of Paracas.

08:00 – Boat excursion to the Ballestas Islands.

From the port of Paracas, take a speedboat to the Ballestas Islands, often called Peru's Little Galápagos. On the way, you'll see the Candelabra, a mysterious geoglyph etched into a sandy slope on the Paracas Peninsula.

The islands are known for their wildlife, including sea lions, pelicans, cormorants and many other seabirds. The coastline is dotted with unusual rock formations and sea caves, with open views over the Pacific.

After the boat trip, continue to the Nazca area for a flight over the famous Nazca Lines, one of Peru's most enigmatic archaeological sites. The desert floor preserves enormous figures depicting animals, birds, a human figure and geometric shapes. Many of these geoglyphs can only be fully appreciated from the air. Their origins and purpose continue to draw the interest of researchers around the world.

Lunch at a restaurant serving Peruvian cuisine is included during the excursion.

Return to Lima by coach in the afternoon.

Overnight at the 4-star Ikonik hotel or a similar hotel of the same category.
